preparation.required_evidence: Real pair direction and deviation from the pure real subfamily; register state TV coverage.

angles_and_pulses.required_evidence: Vertical reference, signed Pockels transfer and angle errors; no phase or sign inferred from outcomes.

eta.required_evidence: Separate absolute/system efficiency runs with a justified Klyshko or detector calibration method, spectral/temporal matching and joint coverage; no target-run coincidence estimate.

assignment.required_evidence: Separate port/extinction tests for F0/F1; blocked port has eta_minus=0 by geometry, leakage is not discarded.

background.required_evidence: Independent blocked-source runs matched to the predeclared slot/window and epoch.

pair_probability.required_evidence: Independent pump/source occupancy calibration for the trial unit; never estimate q by conditioning on detected test pairs.

visibility.required_evidence: Separate characterization with registered target-state dependence; depolarizing approximation must be bounded.

model_tv.required_evidence: Multipair, crosstalk, leakage, dead time and non-independent background/assignment residual TV bounds.

epoch_and_drift.required_evidence: Run joins, calibration/test disjointness and conditional per-step drift coverage.

trial_format.required_evidence: One pulse-slot/window and sync policy, setting anomalies, clock-alignment prefix exclusion and stopping rule fixed without test reads.

joint_coverage.required_evidence: One simultaneous parameter/transport region with beta=1/100, not a collection of unadjusted marginal intervals.

nominal_optimum.required_evidence: Original or independently justified apparatus objective plus nominal channel inputs and rounding criterion; certify controls before any test data.
